templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_5E_INTERACTION_PAIR_BASE
templates.behavior: Reverse-slot spawn of a type-0x5E actor, followed by a linked type-0x84 companion.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_INTERACTION_PAIR_COMPANION
templates.behavior: Companion side of the type-0x5E pair; callers link it to the first actor and publish placement/movement state.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_67_INTERACTION
templates.behavior: Direct forward-slot spawn with animation 0x00123274 ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE67_INTERACTION.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_INTERACTION_BASE
templates.behavior: Shared reverse-slot base; each caller installs an event-specific animation root and adjusts Y by eight pixels.

conclusion: The early interaction block establishes five additional exact 20-byte actor-template records, including a linked pair. No adjacent record outside the direct consumers is promoted.
